nodes.name: Conjecture 10
nodes.statement: Every connected graph $G$ with $\alpha(G) = 2$ has a non-empty connected dominating matching.

nodes.name: Conjecture 8
nodes.statement: Every graph $G$ with $\alpha(G) = 2$ has a $K_{\chi(G)}$-model in which each branch set has size at most $2$.

nodes.name: Conjecture 9
nodes.statement: Every graph $G$ with $\alpha(G) = 2$ has a $K_{\left\lceil |V(G)|/2 \right\rceil}$-model in which each branch set has size at most $2$.

nodes.name: Conjecture 7
nodes.statement: For every integer $t \geqslant 1$, every graph $G$ with $\alpha(G) = 2$ with at least $4t - 1$ vertices has a connected matching of size at least $t$.

nodes.name: Conjecture 6
nodes.statement: There is a constant $c > 0$ such that every graph $G$ with $\alpha(G) = 2$ has a connected matching of size at least $c|V(G)|$.

nodes.name: Conjecture 5
nodes.statement: There is a constant $\varepsilon > 0$ such that every graph $G$ with $\alpha(G) = 2$ satisfies $\mathrm{had}(G) \geqslant (\frac{1}{3} + \varepsilon) |V(G)|$.

nodes.name: Theorem 2.14
nodes.statement:
egin{itemize}
        \item 
ameref{conj:hc_chi} is equivalent to 
ameref{conj:hc_half}. More precisely, any counterexample to 
ameref{conj:hc_half} is a counterexample to 
ameref{conj:hc_chi}, and any minimal counterexample to 
ameref{conj:hc_chi} is a counterexample to 
ameref{conj:hc_half} [PST03].
        \item 
ameref{conj:shc_chi} is equivalent to 
ameref{conj:shc_half}. More precisely, any counterexample to 
ameref{conj:shc_half} is a counterexample to 
ameref{conj:shc_chi}, and any minimal counterexample to 
ameref{conj:shc_chi} is a counterexample to 
ameref{conj:shc_half}.
        \item 
ameref{conj:cdm} implies 
ameref{conj:shc_chi}, which implies 
ameref{conj:hc_chi}.
    \end{itemize}
